_comment: Eval cases for the email classifier. Cases without a `tags` field inherit `default_tags`. Assertions: `category` = exact match (string, or list = any-of); `not_category` = prediction must NOT equal this (string, or list = none-of; used for counter-cases where the exact topic tag doesn't matter, only that it did NOT over-correct into e.g. 'Pending Response'); `response_required` = optional boolean check. Every case must set either `category` or `not_category`.

default_tags.name: Pending Response
default_tags.description: Emails from a real person that need you to reply or take a personal action.

default_tags.name: Action Needed
default_tags.description: Automated or system emails that still need a human decision (renew, approve, pay, resolve).

default_tags.name: Payments
default_tags.description: Invoices, receipts, payment confirmations, and billing.

default_tags.name: ValueFlow
default_tags.description: Shared files, documents, decks, and deliverables.

cases.note: SCREENSHOT 4. Vendor rep cold-pitching a meetup at a conference. Hand-written, uses the recipient's name and references their live CASA assessment, and ends with a direct 'which date and time work for you' -> still cold outreach, NOT Pending Response. This is the case that motivated the cold-outreach rule.

email.subject: Google CASA - will you be at Black Hat Las Vegas next week?
email.bodySnippet: Hello Lakshay, How are you doing? I hope your CASA assessment is going well. If you have any feedback about the process or need any support, please feel free to let me know. Also, I'll be in Las Vegas with our CASA team for Black Hat USA from August 3-6. If you're attending the event or will be in the city, I'd be happy to find a convenient time to meet, say hello, and hear about your experience with the assessment so we can better support your future projects. We can also discuss any other cybersecurity or compliance needs you may have, including SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO, GDPR, or penetration testing. If you're available, please let me know which date and time work best for you. I'd love to connect in person or online. Looking forward to it. Best, Duy Anh
